title: I asked AI to draw a LEFT-handed writer ✍️

beats.big:
Draw someone
writing with
their LEFT hand.
beats.say: I asked AI to draw someone writing with their left hand.
ChatGPT. Here you go. Right hand.
Okay, another AI. Stable Diffusion. Right hand again.
Grok made four pictures. All four. Right hand.

beats.big:
Why can't
it find the
left hand?
beats.say: So why can't AI find the left hand?
Only about ten percent of people are left-handed. So most photos AI learned from show a right hand.

beats.big:
It draws
what it saw
most.
beats.say: It doesn't draw what you asked for. It draws what it saw most.
Try it yourself, and tell us which hand you got.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
